services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Our field trips are built so students can come back as they grow. Each one fits the age it serves, guided by The Wild Path Home, a research-based guide that maps the outdoor experiences children need at each age, from infancy through the teen years, to grow into adults who care for the land. K-3 - Play. A day to wade, dig, build, and explore at their own pace. Book it any year. 2nd or 3rd grade - Investigate.
